known_limitations: Most samples were captured on bright uniform white/neutral backgrounds with a single isolated object.
Class 'trash' (mapped to 'other') has fewer samples than paper/glass/plastic/metal (~137 vs ~400-594).
Exact or near-duplicate studio captures exist and must be deduplicated before train/val/test splitting.
Real-world mobile captures (cluttered backgrounds, low light, wet/crushed waste, mixed materials) represent domain shift not covered by TrashNet alone.
